purpose: Determine whether the newly configured Tushare Token and existing 3000-point authorization can replace the selected QMT/XtQuant Level-1 one-minute path for the fixed three-session strategy, without requesting provider rows, observing factor values, or reading prices or forward returns.

sources.title: Tushare permissions and frequency table
observed_contract: points-based interfaces and independently purchased interfaces are separate permission modes
historical minute data is excluded from points permissions
A-share historical 1, 5, 15, 30, and 60 minute data begins in 2009
the listed individual historical-minute price is CNY 2000 per year
the listed historical-minute limit is 500 calls per minute and 8000 rows per call
real-time minute data is separately listed at CNY 1000 per month

sources.title: Tushare minute-data usage guide
observed_contract: minute-data permission is purchased separately and is unrelated to platform points
without formal minute permission only trial access is available
historical minute data is requested one instrument at a time
one request returns at most 8000 rows
daily historical-minute updates complete between 17:00 and 21:00

sources.title: Tushare pro_bar interface
observed_contract: stock minute frequencies include 1, 5, 15, 30, and 60 minutes
users with at least 600 points receive only two minute trial requests
formal minute access is governed by the independent permission list

sources.title: Tushare A-share real-time minute daily accumulation
observed_contract: rt_min_daily covers only the current trading day's accumulated minute history
rt_min_daily requires the separate real-time minute permission
current-day real-time access cannot establish 2019-2025 development history

reasons: The configured 3000-point authorization does not include independently purchased historical-minute permission.
Two trial requests cannot satisfy the existing four-symbol, two-exchange acceptance contract or authorize a full-market 2019-2025 snapshot.
Purchasing this source would duplicate the already selected Level-1 OHLCV/amount path rather than add a new economic factor.
The independent real-time permission is not implied by points.
Current-day accumulation cannot supply the frozen 2019-2025 development history or a completed 2026-07-13 acceptance session.
A future-only observation path cannot validate historical factor stability or Top-3 viability.
It matches the existing frozen four-symbol acceptance contract and five preregistered minute features.
It avoids a second CNY 2000 annual data purchase when a lawful broker-side export may already be available.
The exporter and strict offline importer are implemented and tested; only the real Windows-side bundle is missing.

decision.next_external_action: Run the frozen QMT four-symbol acceptance exporter in an already-lawful Windows MiniQMT/XtQuant environment and transfer the untouched bundle for offline validation.
decision.next_local_action_after_bundle: Run acceptance-qmt-1m-export, review all four timestamp boundaries, and store a separate alignment confirmation before freezing any full-source no-return protocol.
